jobs.prompt:
Write tools/merge-guard.mjs: checkRollup, assertMergeable, parsePrArgument and runMerge. runMerge takes (root, args, { exec = real exec through node:child_process execFile with promisify, now }) and is fully testable with a fake exec. Keep it under 12000 characters.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Follow the design exactly: export names, return shapes, reasons and the refusal of every other flag are fixed.

Write the test file for the merge guard module (module written at the same time; use exactly the names in the design). Use a fake exec that records every command. Cover: checkRollup with all green, a failure, a cancelled older run replaced by a newer success, a newer failure after an older success, pending runs, status contexts, neutral and skipped, empty and non-array rollups; assertMergeable for every reason; parsePrArgument forms; runMerge happy path (the exact gh arguments, squash, delete-branch, match-head-commit, then the local pull), a red check (no merge call is ever made), a pending check, no checks, stacked PRs open, a non-default base, every refused flag, a merge failure, a state not MERGED after the call, and a dirty work tree skipping the local update without failing the merge.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Follow the design exactly: export names, return shapes, reasons and the refusal of every other flag are fixed.
